messages:
Priya (docs): Heads-up: customer reported a mismatch for GET /v1/usage/summary. Our API ref shows an array of daily entries but the service returns a top-level object with totals and a `by_day` map.

Ellen (support): Customer copied the example and tried to iterate the response as a list, hit a KeyError. They shared the raw payload: {"total_tokens":12345,"by_day":{"2026-03-01":{"tokens":1234}}}.

Marcus (eng): Oh, that was changed last month when we added aggregation. OpenAPI wasn't updated. The schema should be object with `total_tokens` (int) and `by_day` (object<string, {tokens:int,requests:int}>). Example response should show 200 with that object.

Priya (docs): I'll patch the OpenAPI example and replace the array example. Also will add a short note: "response changed from array to object with totals on 2026-02-15" for migration.

Lina (sdk): SDK wrappers expect the object already (we updated them), but docs examples caused confusion for users using direct HTTP. I'll update the example snippets in the docs site and add a one-line code sample showing how to read `by_day`.

Marcus (eng): Tests: I'll add an OpenAPI-backed test to validate example payload shape matches runtime.

Priya (docs): Draft curl example to add to the page:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/summary
# Response: {"total_tokens":12345,"by_day":{"2026-03-01":{"tokens":1234,"requests":12}}}
```

Priya (docs): Opening PR now with OpenAPI patch + migration note. Requesting Marcus and Lina for quick review.

docs-bot: PR opened by Priya (docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4338 labels: docs,bugfix

Marcus (eng): Reviewing. If tests pass I'll merge. Good catch, Ellen.

Ellen (support): I'll send the corrected snippet to the customer and mark the support ticket resolved after they confirm.

Lina (sdk): Docs PR merged? Once merged I'll add a link from the SDK README to the updated endpoint notes.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4338 (merged by Marcus)

Priya (docs): Done. Action items: [x] Update OpenAPI and examples, [x] Add migration note, [x] Notify customer, [x] Add test. Closing thread.
